description: Rational-function (អនុគមន៍សនិទាន) full curve-study drills: domain + oblique/vertical asymptote finding, algebraic decomposition f(x)=ax+b+c/(x-k), sign of f'(x) from a given derivative expression, and full multi-part function studies (domain, limits, asymptotes, derivative, variation table, tangent lines, sketching the curve C, and a parametrized-family variant f_m).

source.file: book/Start Up Part 1.pdf + book/Part 2.pdf (physical book pages 29-37)
source.description: Cambodian BAC II grade-12 math exercise compendium (Start Up Community), Lesson 5: អនុគមន៍សនិទាន (Rational Functions) — exercises only, no worked solutions
source.extracted_by: manual OCR/transcription from scanned textbook (Claude Code), 2026-08-28

exercises.technique: Find domain of definition and identify function shape (all quadratic-over-linear or quadratic-over-quadratic rational forms)
Sign-of-derivative analysis (determine numerator sign / roots to build a variation table) without differentiating, from an already-given f'(x)
Classify the variation shape / determine local extrema type from the rational-function form
Verify a given point is the curve's inflection point using f''(point)=0

exercises.technique: Full rational-function study (BAC-II style, ~4-6 parts each): domain, limits at infinity/poles, asymptotes (vertical + oblique + curvilinear), derivative & sign, variation table, tangent line, intersection with asymptote/axes, sketch curve C; several ask for an unknown coefficient (a,b,c,m) satisfying a symmetry, extremum, or asymptote condition first
Full rational-function study with a parametrized family f_m(x), studying variation for all m then solving for a specific m satisfying a geometric condition
